justification: OC-20 (user decision 2026-10-17, option 1): the claim is checked in three parts instead of DQ-145 = 0. (a) a clause number is shown only when a script proved it, else the page (#1170/#1307 tests); (b) every citation surface renders the 'Citation not yet checked' mark for an unproven rule (#1313 tests incl. the badge inventory); (c) DQ-145 is a ratchet at 1,011 that may only fall, run with the probe's own SQL. OC-20 declared true; claim wording is the approved draft's.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/test_outreach_claim_checks_oc20.py && python scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py OC-20
falsifiable_check.fails_when: DQ-145 exceeds 1,011, any citation test fails (a card stops rendering the mark, the server flag drifts from DQ-145, a clause shows unproven), or the DQ-145 query breaks
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Mutating the ratchet from <= to < made test_at_ceiling_passes fail (1 failed, 6 passed); restored, 7 passed.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/outreach_claim_checks.py: the ratchet runs the DQ-145 probe SQL unchanged; unit tests use a fake connection and assert the exact SQL and params are passed; the live run read 1,011

pre_impl.existing_data: DQ-145 probe SQL in scripts/dq_probe_live.PROBES; jest_file and pytest_files helpers already run OC-9's tests
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: none found: the probe SQL and helper signatures matched what the check needs
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: reuses the probe SQL and the existing helpers; adds one ratchet function

functions.name: unproven_citations_only_fall
functions.input: a live database connection from dq_db.connect, or None when unreachable
functions.if_none: UNKNOWN when the DB is unreachable; FAIL when the query errors

break_it.scenario: the database cannot be reached from where the gate runs
break_it.what_happens: the ratchet reports UNKNOWN and the claim is not verified, never PASS

break_it.scenario: probe SQL references a dropped column
break_it.what_happens: the ratchet reports FAIL with the query error in its detail line
jest exits non-zero (no tests found) -> FAIL

mutation_analysis: Changing <= to < in the ratchet fails test_at_ceiling_passes. Removing the ratchet from CLAIMS fails test_oc20_is_wired_with_all_three_parts.
residual_risk: The badge inventory checks each file, not each citation expression: a component with one badge and a second bare citation passes (Sol, 2026-10-17). Hard-wired checked={false} cards always show the mark. The ceiling must be lowered by hand after each proof pass.

post_merge.manual_verify: python scripts/dq_check.py --outreach on main prints 21 of 21
